ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human review as a SAFE-1 safety incident (threats/intimidation): hand the reviewer the verbatim 18:24 exchange and the driver's statement, and record the outcome against both accounts. No fare, refund or fee action on this trip; no account flag is raised by this ruling.
ruling.reasoning: Safety screen first. I read every chat message, the driver's statement and the complaint. At 18:24 the driver wrote "Please do not smoke in the car." [F3] and the rider replied "Say that again and I will punch you." [F4]. That is a threat of physical violence aimed at the other party, made in the in-app record and timestamped [F5], and the driver's later statement repeats it consistently (he asked politely, kept driving, did not reply) [F6]. The rider advocate concedes the same reading (C1, revised ask) and the driver's brief relies on it (D1, D3). This is the "Threats and Intimidation" the Code of Conduct bars and abuse of the other party under SAFE-1, so the case is a safety incident and cannot be decided automatically: the disposition is escalate with a factual summary, not a fare ruling [F3][F4][F6][SAFE-1].
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-1 safety event: the rider's own timestamped in-app message F4 ("Say that again and I will punch you.") is a threat of physical violence directed at the driver, sent at 18:24 immediately after the driver's request not to smoke (F3), with the driver's after-trip statement F6 consistent and uncontradicted. The chat record is complete and every message timestamped (F5), so nothing needs recovering and no further facts are missing. For the reviewer: what happened (smoking request → threat), when (18:24, during the metered trip Tampines Mall → Changi Airport T3, 18:15–18:28), what is disputed (weight and consequence of F4, and whether any mitigation exists — there is no message after F4 in the record), which facts to check (F3, F4, F5, F6; both profiles F7/F8 are background only and cannot decide anything). SAFE-2 is not engaged: the record contains no collision, injury or dangerous-driving allegation, and the metered trip ran 8.5 km against an optimal 8.5 km in 13.2 min (F1, F2), so the driver's driving is not in issue. No fare question exists on this file (no off-route segment, no fare fact), so the only open matter is the conduct report under SAFE-1.
